title: Safe undo: undoing a trained-on label must not wipe learned structure
description: Today undo_review of a label that was in the fit invalidates the fit and resets the classifier to its initial config, discarding the learned rubric, supporting questions and example list (flywheel.py:763-780). Undo must instead remove that label's influence without wiping unrelated learned structure (e.g. refit from the current config without the label, or re-measure the incumbent), or at minimum warn and require confirmation before a reset. Specs prove a learned rubric/questions/examples survive undo of one trained-on label. Scheduled ahead of M1-M4 by Ryan 2026-10-21. Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/Jg1DpixLFcAvnPy7d9RNDE

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Cyclotron/pull/95. reconcile_feedback no longer resets to the initial config: it drops the head, its evidence fingerprints and the changed item from example_ids, keeps rubric/questions/other examples, and the next learning pass refits and re-measures without the label. classifier-invalidated event now carries reset_to_initial=false, changed_item_ids, retained and a warning that optimizer-written wording may still reflect the label. Specs: flywheel_test (3 new), embedded_cyclotron_test (1 new end-to-end undo_review), workspace_session_test (3 assertions updated from wipe to survive). make check PYTHON=.venv/bin/python exits 0 (2381 passed, trace-ui build, bundle drift clean).
